div.head: VIIa Atr 6.2
div.ab: ⁊ þar to eacan mæssige man æghwilce dæge on ælcan minstre ane mæssan sinderlice for ðare neode, þe us nu on handa stent, oð þæt hit betere wurðe.
⁊ þar to eacan mæssige man æghwilce dæge on ælcan minstre ane mæssan sinderlice for ðare neode þe us nu on handa stent, oð þæt hit betere wurðe.
And þartoeacan mæssige man æghwilce dæge on ælcan minstre ane mæssan sinderlice for ðare neode, þe us nu on handa stent, oð þæt hit betere wurðe.
And in addition, in every religious foundation, one mass shall be said daily with special reference to the distress with which we are now afflicted, until an improvement takes place.
Additionally, a special Mass is to be celebrated each day in every church because of the peril that confronts us until it is resolved.
And in addition one mass is to be said every day in each minster with special reference to the need which is now urgent for us, until things become better.
Und ausserdem werde an jedem Tage in jeder Kirche Eine Messe gelesen besonders für die Noth, die uns jetzt vorhanden ist, bis dass es besser werde.
And in addition let one mass be said every day in every minster especially for the need that is now upon us, until things get better.
div.note: id. (3) names the mass “Against the heathen” and says it is to be at matins
